name: subagent_list
description: List every sub-agent you've spawned in this session (via subagent_new), with display name, mode, current status, and child session id. Pair with `subagent_resume` to send a follow-up message to one of them — the `name` field here is the handle `subagent_resume` takes. An empty list means you haven't spawned any sub-agents yet.
